
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path

p = Path("index.qmd")
content = p.read_text()

old = 'filter(!is.na(Score), `Measure ID` %in% c("OP-10", "OP-39"))'
new = 'dplyr::filter(!is.na(Score), `Measure ID` %in% c("OP-10", "OP-39"))'

if old not in content:
    raise SystemExit("No se encontró la línea esperada. No se modificó nada.")

content = content.replace(old, new, 1)
p.write_text(content)

print("Error corregido correctamente.")
PY
